scenario_scope: Primary-source intake of Kimi K3 architecture and training mechanisms into existing substrate, routing, and governed-training owners.

cases.decision_rationale: KDA, AttnRes, Stable LatentMoE, Quantile Balancing, SiTU-GLU, and Per-Head Muon strengthen existing substrate, routing, and training interfaces; the branded integrated system is not a new chapter boundary.
required_before_drafting: explicit separation of provider-reported and locally reproduced evidence
scale, context, sparsity, and hardware transfer limits
promotion_blockers: aggregate architecture/data/training/system result has no component-level causal attribution
non_claims: does not establish Kimi K3 superiority
does not select any mechanism for Project Theseus

cases.decision_rationale: A model-specific chapter would duplicate substrate, routing, optimization, scaling, and evidence boundaries already owned elsewhere.
evidence_transition_preconditions: a future distinct interface or failure mode would require fresh boundary review
promotion_blockers: novelty and scale are not chapter boundaries
non_claims: does not reserve a future model-specific chapter

validation_boundary: Records source routing and duplicate-chapter rejection only. It does not validate Kimi K3 implementations, benchmarks, scaling efficiency, safety, transfer, or any Project Theseus candidate.
non_claims: does not authorize training, evaluation, release, or deployment
